limits: This is exact final saved-file authentication, not new biological review, current native validation, a restored commit, or publication approval.
Direct original hash tokens are supporting observations; decisive finality comes from original accepted closure hash to preserved archive manifest to exact saved bytes.
Original historical publication hold is recorded as historical state; ROOT separately owns the current authorized recovery/publication workflow.
Prepared YAML may normalize during native save; no unconditional prepared-byte equality is required.
Only the read-only backup and original timestamp-bounded transcript are consumed; historical /private/tmp paths are data and never accessed.
